<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Parliament Street protests:</strong> Rahul Gandhi and Congress leaders staged a dharna at the Parliament Street police station to demand an FIR regarding alleged police action against a pellet victim, drawing sharp criticism from the BJP.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I21</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Delimitation session:</strong> The Union government is keeping the option open for a special session of Parliament to potentially introduce a bill on the delimitation of constituencies.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE5GcXVBUHhRQU94c0xuQml2U2s0QlhSaXpMWFB3MjQ0YThxV0dkc250dFNnY2pLUzh4RWlCN3o2d0VON1FWTWRoVDRjTElPY015cjRRWVZ5RW81bDRVU2NKYlRaOEpYU0J6U1Mwc21IUTctUQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Vande Mataram row:</strong> Rajya Sabha MP Kapil Sibal challenged the BJP over the Vande Mataram controversy, questioning the party&#x27;s historical consistency in singing all stanzas of the national song.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Education policy review:</strong> The Supreme Court has directed a reconsideration of the CBSE&#x27;s three-language policy, specifically raising concerns regarding its implementation for Class 6 students.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxOMVFyRmZFN25zMF9mUmVoUmNqWlJHMllwOUQzVWgtRHhlY0d2cExrVzVOSmE4a2JQaUxjeGkzSEwyd21od054NzFlcjU0eXVpbGlFV1ZLYUJnRFRjU2lPRDdLU2NfelZUanJJMlg5M3NtQ1h2RTZvLUFxaFdON3ZyQXpzSGlsdw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
